questions.text: When you encounter someone who stirs your soul, how do you tend to move?

options.text: I reach out proactively, creating the first spark in our unfolding story.
I wait for the universe to align, letting the other person initiate our connection.

questions.text: How quickly does the fire of attraction usually ignite within you?

options.text: It is a sudden lightning strike; I know the depth of my interest almost instantly.
It is a gentle dawn; my feelings grow steadily as I truly come to know the other.

questions.text: How do you signal your interest to those who captivate you?

options.text: I am an open book, wearing my admiration clearly through vibrant words and gestures.
I weave a subtle web of mystery, letting my interest be felt through silence and nuance.

questions.text: When conflict clouds the emotional landscape, what is your natural reaction?

options.text: I face the storm head-on, addressing the core issue with immediate honesty.
I navigate the periphery first, seeking a softer, more reflective path to reconciliation.

questions.text: If a social gathering presents a potential connection, what is your instinct?

options.text: I move towards them with intent, making my presence felt from the start.
I remain in my own space, allowing others to gravitate towards me first.

questions.text: What is your typical pace when unfolding the chapters of a new romance?

options.text: I dive into the depths early, eager to explore the intensity of our bond.
I savor the shallow waters first, building trust and familiarity over time.

questions.text: What is the primary language of your romantic interest?

options.text: Generous compliments and clear, heartfelt declarations of my feelings.
Intense eye contact and subtle shifts in energy that invite curiosity.

questions.text: How do you protect your inner sanctuary when tensions arise?

options.text: I state my boundaries clearly and forcefully to prevent misunderstanding.
I withdraw slightly to process, allowing the atmosphere to cool before re-engaging.

questions.text: In the dance of connection, who do you prefer should set the rhythm?

options.text: I prefer to take the lead, ensuring our momentum continues to build.
I prefer to respond to their lead, finding grace in the flow they initiate.

questions.text: Does your heart usually decide quickly, or does it require extensive evidence?

options.text: My heart is a fast-flowing river, easily swept away by a powerful connection.
My heart is a steady mountain, requiring time and consistency to be moved.

questions.text: How much of your romantic intention do you reveal initially?

options.text: I make my intentions obvious, leaving no room for doubt about my interest.
I keep my intentions hidden behind a veil of intrigue, letting them guess.

questions.text: What is your typical approach to resolving a heated disagreement?

options.text: I prioritize 'getting it out' and reaching a resolution as quickly as possible.
I prioritize 'cooling down' and addressing the emotional fallout before the facts.
